title: Difference of actual restrictions commutes with stage transitions and cone legs
statement: Let I be a preorder, D:I^op → Sch [def-pc-scheme] a diagram with cone c [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and F_i abelian étale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For f:i→j let φ_f:D(f^op)^*F_i→F_j be arbitrary coefficient morphisms [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let G:I→Ab(c.pt_et) have specified isomorphisms eG_i:G_i≅c_i^*F_i, and L a cocone on G. Fix X, opens U,V [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], q≥0, i₀∈I and g₀:D_i₀→X. Put J=I_{≥i₀}, g_j=D(j→i₀);g₀ and g_L=c_i₀;g₀. For W an open of X write W_j=g_j^{-1}W, W_L=g_L^{-1}W, A_W(j)=H^q(W_j,F_j|), A_W(L)=H^q(W_L,L.pt|) [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Denote by T_W(f) and λ_W(j) the actual canonical restricted cohomology maps of tailOpenCohomologyMapDegree and tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree [lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-open-cohomology-cocone-degree]: restricted pullback followed by the coefficient morphism obtained using inverse-image composition comparisons from φ_f or (eG_j)^-1;L_j, respectively [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Define d_j:A_U(j)×A_V(j)→A_{U∩V}(j) by d_j(x,y)=res_{U∩V,U}(x)-res_{U∩V,V}(y), with restrictions openCohomologyRestriction along the inverse-image inclusions; define d_L by the identical formula at g_L with coefficient L.pt. No identity/composition laws on φ or canonical-arrow formula for G are assumed. For every f:j→k and x,y, d_k(T_U(f)x,T_V(f)y)=T_{U∩V}(f)(d_j(x,y)); and for every j,x,y, d_L(λ_U(j)x,λ_V(j)y)=λ_{U∩V}(j)(d_j(x,y)). No covering condition is needed. The Lean statement presents the same differences as additive maps characterized on every input by these restriction formulas, which determine the maps uniquely by extensionality; it asserts their existence together with both naturality equations.

source.place: Tag 0A50, proof and coefficient functoriality; Tag 09YQ, coherent-system restriction maps. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A50 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YQ; the compatibility extension is agent-written.

proof.text: Construct each difference homomorphism as x ↦ res_U(x.1) - res_V(x.2). Zero and addition are preserved by the restrictions and the abelian group subtraction identity. The displayed value formulas hold by reflexivity.

Apply stage single-restriction naturality to U∩V ≤ U and U∩V ≤ V. Apply the proved elementary differenceMap_natural helper: substitute the two component equalities and use the intersection transition homomorphism's map_sub law. Apply cone single-restriction naturality to the same two inclusions and finish using the intersection leg's map_sub law. These are genuine component-square statements; the construction of the difference maps and the combination of the component squares are proved in the parent.

theorem tailOpenDifference_naturality
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens)
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (L : Cocone G) (q : ℕ) (i₀ : I) (g₀ : D.obj (op i₀) ⟶ X)
    :
    ∃ (d : ∀ j : Set.Ici i₀,
      (Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (tailStageOpen D g₀ U j).ι).obj
        (F j.val)) q ×
       Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (tailStageOpen D g₀ V j).ι).obj
        (F j.val)) q) →+
      Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (tailStageOpen D g₀ (U ⊓ V) j).ι).obj
        (F j.val)) q)
    (dL : (Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj L.pt) q ×
      Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj L.pt) q) →+
      Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ (U ⊓ V)).ι).obj L.pt) q),
    (∀ j x, d j x =
      openCohomologyRestriction (X := D.obj (op j.val))
        (A := tailStageOpen D g₀ (U ⊓ V) j) (B := tailStageOpen D g₀ U j)
        ((D.map (homOfLE j.property).op ≫ g₀).preimage_mono
          (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)) (F j.val) q x.1 -
      openCohomologyRestriction (X := D.obj (op j.val))
        (A := tailStageOpen D g₀ (U ⊓ V) j) (B := tailStageOpen D g₀ V j)
        ((D.map (homOfLE j.property).op ≫ g₀).preimage_mono
          (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)) (F j.val) q x.2) ∧
    (∀ x, dL x =
      openCohomologyRestriction (X := c.pt)
        (A := (c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ (U ⊓ V))
        (B := (c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀).preimage_mono (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)) L.pt q x.1 -
      openCohomologyRestriction (X := c.pt)
        (A := (c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ (U ⊓ V))
        (B := (c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ V)
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀).preimage_mono (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)) L.pt q x.2) ∧
    (∀ (j k : Set.Ici i₀) (f : j ⟶ k)
      (x : Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (tailStageOpen D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ U j).ι).obj (F j.val)) q)
      (y : Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (tailStageOpen D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ V j).ι).obj (F j.val)) q),
      d k ((tailOpenCohomologyMapDegree D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ U F φ q f).hom x,
        (tailOpenCohomologyMapDegree D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ V F φ q f).hom y) =
      (tailOpenCohomologyMapDegree D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ (U ⊓ V) F φ q f).hom (d j (x, y))) ∧
    (∀ (j : Set.Ici i₀)
      (x : Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (tailStageOpen D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ U j).ι).obj (F j.val)) q)
      (y : Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (tailStageOpen D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ V j).ι).obj (F j.val)) q),
      dL ((tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree D c (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ U F G eG L q j).hom x,
        (tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree D c (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ V F G eG L q j).hom y) =
      (tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree D c (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ (U ⊓ V) F G eG L q j).hom
        (d j (x, y)))
